data.one_liner: Aggregated exports of all Material 3 Expressive components and design tokens for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a single import that re-exports all Material 3 Expressive component packages, design tokens, and associated shape and refresh libraries. It allows developers to depend on one package to access a full suite of M3E components like app bars, buttons, floating action buttons, navigation bars, sliders, and toolbars.
use_when: You want to build an application using the Material 3 Expressive design system.
You prefer a single dependency and import for multiple M3E UI components.
avoid_when: You only need a single isolated component from the collection and prefer to keep dependencies minimal.
Your project uses standard Material Design without the Expressive variations.
strengths: Simplifies dependency management by grouping related Material 3 Expressive packages.
Includes a wide range of pre-built UI components with token-driven colors and shapes.
weaknesses: Brings in a large set of dependent packages whether you use all of them or not.
Tied to a specific ecosystem of M3E packages.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the collection.
